stem: Which option is an example of nutritional insufficiency contributing to short stature?
explanation: Poor intake is an example of nutritional insufficiency contributing to short stature.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Assessment of Childhood Short Stature

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because Crohn's disease is an example of systemic disease or inflammation, not nutritional insufficiency specifically
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because delayed skeletal maturation is associated with constitutional delay
optionExplanations.C: Correct because poor intake is listed as an example of nutritional insufficiency contributing to short stature
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because body disproportion suggests skeletal dysplasia
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because being within 3 centiles of mid-parental height supports familial short stature rather than nutritional insufficiency
